mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 0.5% signals accommodative monetary policy that reduces equity discount rates, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through lower cost of capital for corporate valuation.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeding 7.5% indicates labor market deterioration that precedes reduced consumer spending and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward return is positive in more than 50% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 7.5%, or the Rank IC over a 2-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 2.5%) and low interest rates (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) signal stagflationary risks that increase equity risk premiums, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward return is positive in more than 50% of periods meeting the trigger condition, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansions, a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 98.0 indicates manufacturing weakness that precedes earnings deterioration and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is positive in more than 50% of periods during late-cycle expansions when INDPRO falls below 98.0, or the Rank IC over a 2-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) above 900.0 thousand units signals strong consumer demand that boosts retail sales and corporate revenues, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward return is negative in more than 50% of periods when HOUST exceeds 900.0, or the Rank IC over a 2-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) above 135,000 thousand indicates labor market strength that supports consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward return is negative in more than 50% of observations when PAYEMS is above its 12-month moving average, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST > 900.0) and retail sales (RSAFS > 410,000 million dollars) indicates robust consumer demand that accelerates corporate revenue growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is negative in more than 50% of periods meeting the trigger condition, or the Rank IC over a 2-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in consumer inflation (CPIAUCSL) above 2.5% signals accelerating price pressures that may trigger monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward return is positive in more than 50% of periods when CPIAUCSL exceeds 2.5%, or the Rank IC over a 2-year rolling window is below 0.03.
